packages.title: Reminder question moves into the list, with copy for cold start
brief: What round 1 did (P32): ReminderAskCard (App/lib/widgets/reminder_ask_card.dart) sits at the top of TaskActions (App/lib/widgets/task_actions.dart:19), which is the Scaffold's bottomNavigationBar on Calendar (calendar_screen.dart:532) and on Tareas and project pages (home_screen.dart:267). It is capped at half the screen height and scrolls inside itself (reminder_ask_card.dart:71-80). Everything else in P32 was verified: when it shows, the copy, storing `asked` before acting, `Sí` running turnOnReminders, the 9:00 default. Keep all of that.

Why it failed (UX-401): a fixed bottom bar takes height from the agenda. ux-tester's App/test/reminder_ask_card_test.dart:122, at 320×568 with 2× text: the bar spans y=80 to 496 (the card alone 282 px), Calendar's agenda gets a 16 px viewport, and the dated task `Comprar pan` is never on screen, even after scrolling. With the real Manrope font the bar is still about 348 px. A smaller cap would hide `Sí, recuérdamelo` inside the card's own scroll, so don't tune the cap.

1. Move the card out of the fixed bar and into the scrolling content, after the tasks. Delete `const ReminderAskCard()` and its import from task_actions.dart:19. In reminder_ask_card.dart delete the ConstrainedBox (maxHeight = height / 2) and the inner SingleChildScrollView: the card now scrolls with the list, so it needs neither. Then add the card as the last item of: (a) Calendar's CustomScrollView (calendar_screen.dart:122), as a final SliverToBoxAdapter after the agenda, the overdue section and any empty state; (b) Tareas and project pages: give TaskList (App/lib/widgets/task_list.dart:11) an optional `footer` widget appended as the last item, and have home_screen.dart:250 pass the card; also add it after the EmptyState in home_screen.dart:230, so a Tareas page with no rows still asks when dated tasks exist elsewhere. In both home_screen places, don't show the card while a search is typed (`_query` isn't empty). Match each list's horizontal padding (Calendar uses 24). The show conditions in reminder_ask_card.dart:48-66 are unchanged.
Result: the task just added is always above the card and never loses room to it. For a new user with a few tasks, the card sits right below them, near the thumb, as before.

2. Keep the shared action working from inside a list. turnOnReminders(context) (App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart:37) uses the card's context for the exact-alarm sheet and the confirmation, and a lazy ListView may dispose the hidden card. Keep the card's State alive until the action finishes. Either use AutomaticKeepAliveClientMixin with wantKeepAlive true while it runs, or pass turnOnReminders a context that outlives the card (the screen's). The comment at reminder_ask_card.dart:20-22 must stay true.

3. UX-438 (regression R1D-1): `¿Quieres un recordatorio antes?` has no referent when the card appears at launch for an account that already had dated tasks. The owner's D2a ties the question to ‘the first saved task with a date’. Keep the owner's copy for that moment and use a general sentence otherwise. Add an in-memory, per-session record: per ownerKey, the ids of the open dated tasks present when taskProvider first delivers data in this app process. Put it in App/lib/providers/reminder_provider.dart; it is not persisted. If any current open dated task's id is not in that set, a dated task was saved this session: show the existing `reminderAskQuestion` (EN `Want a reminder before it?` / ES `¿Quieres un recordatorio antes?` / CA `Vols un recordatori abans?`). Otherwise show a new key `reminderAskQuestionTasks`: EN `Want reminders before your tasks?` / ES `¿Quieres recordatorios antes de tus tareas?` / CA `Vols recordatoris abans de les teves tasques?`. The buttons are unchanged. The two known edge cases are acceptable, so don't build anything for them: a task that only arrives through sync during the session also counts as new, and an offline id that is swapped for a server id counts as new.
Run gen-l10n after the ARB edits. Update the existing tests in reminder_ask_card_test.dart that look for the card inside TaskActions; don't weaken :122, which must now pass as written.
Don't touch: turnOnReminders' steps, `asked` storage, the 9:00 default, the chip, Notificaciones, P50's strings (exact-alarm label and confirmation copy). No new setting, screen or snackbar.
acceptance: Widget test (the existing reminder_ask_card_test.dart:122, unchanged): on Calendar at 320×568 with 2× text, in Spanish, with reminders off, the question unanswered and one open task `Comprar pan` dated today, the TaskTile `Comprar pan` is hit-testable. After scrolling to the end, `Sí, recuérdamelo` and `Ahora no` are hit-testable too.
Widget test: on the same screen at 390×844 with 1× text, the card is visible without scrolling, below `Comprar pan`, and no ReminderAskCard is a descendant of TaskActions.

Widget test: in Spanish, an account whose dated task is already loaded at launch sees `¿Quieres recordatorios antes de tus tareas?`. After a new dated task is added in the same session, the card reads `¿Quieres un recordatorio antes?`.
Widget test: a fresh account with no tasks at launch sees no card. Once a dated task is added, the card reads `¿Quieres un recordatorio antes?` with `Sí, recuérdamelo` and `Ahora no`.

Widget test, with reminderAccessProvider faked as supported, permission granted and exact alarms off: tapping `Sí, recuérdamelo` on the card in Tareas' list opens the exact-alarm sheet, and reminders end up on. This proves the card's context survives inside the list.
Widget test: on Tareas, with a search typed, the card is not shown. With the search cleared, it is the last item of the list.

Code: the EN and CA catalogs carry `reminderAskQuestionTasks` as `Want reminders before your tasks?` and `Vols recordatoris abans de les teves tasques?`. task_actions.dart no longer references ReminderAskCard, and reminder_ask_card.dart has no maxHeight cap.
deviceChecks: Android phone at the largest font size, Spanish: create a task for tomorrow. On Calendar, the task shows with the card below it, and `Sí, recuérdamelo` brings up the system permission dialog, then the exact-alarm screen if Android asks, then the confirmation.
From round 1, still pending: the Android 13+ permission dialog, the Android 14 exact-alarm screen, and a 9:00 reminder firing for a task without a time.

packages.title: Words heard before a speech restart stay in the field
brief: Regression R1A-1 from P33, inferred from code; needs a device. P33 made the native bridge start a new recognizer attempt when one ends through onError (NO_MATCH and other non-fatal errors, NativeSpeechBridge.kt:268-278, via finished() → attemptOver). In Dart, `_nativePrefix` only advances on a `segment` event (voice_task_screen.dart:352-354). If an attempt sent partials but no segment before it ended, the next attempt's first partial replaces the field with prefix + new partial, and the earlier words are lost. Example: ‘comprar pan’, a pause, ‘y leche’ ends as ‘y leche’.

Fix it in Dart only. Don't touch the Kotlin. This needs no APK build, and a mocked-channel test proves it. Every new attempt sends `ready` (onReadyForSpeech, NativeSpeechBridge.kt:248) before its first partial. In `_receiveSpeech` (voice_task_screen.dart:336), when `event.kind == 'ready'`, commit what the field shows: set `_nativePrefix` to `_words.text.trim()`, bounded to 4000 characters like line 353. This is a no-op after a segment, because the field already equals the prefix. It also keeps anything the person typed into the field. Keep it consistent with line 441, which sets the prefix the same way when listening resumes.
Don't touch: the Kotlin bridge, segment handling, the Paused or `recordingKept` states, or diagnostics. No copy changes.
acceptance: Unit or widget test with the native speech channel mocked, on the capture screen: the events partial(`comprar pan`), ready, partial(`y leche`), ended leave the field reading `comprar pan y leche`.
Same test: partial(`comprar pan`), segment(`comprar pan`), ready, partial(`y leche`) leaves `comprar pan y leche`, without repeating `comprar pan`.
Same test: a first `ready` on an empty field, then partial(`hola`), leaves `hola`, with no leading space.
deviceChecks: Android 12 phone (the restart fallback), Spanish: say ‘comprar pan’, stay silent until the recognizer restarts, then say ‘y leche’. The field keeps ‘comprar pan y leche’.
Android 13+ (segmented session): the same sentence with a long pause ends with both parts once.

packages.title: One name for exact alarms; an honest turn-on confirmation
files: tests that look for the old copy (e.g. App/test/reminder_settings_test.dart)
brief: Regressions R1B-1 and R1B-2 from P8's shared turnOnReminders (App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart:37-104).

1. UX-435 (R1B-1): the exact-alarm sheet's sentence `exactAlarmsNeeded` asks for «Alarmas y recordatorios», but its button `allowPreciseAlarms` reads `Permitir alarmas exactas` (reminder_control.dart:84-87). The same button appears on Notificaciones (notification_settings_screen.dart:219-227). Change the value of `allowPreciseAlarms` and keep the key, so both places follow. The new value names the system screen: EN `Allow “Alarms & reminders”` / ES `Permitir «Alarmas y recordatorios»` / CA `Permet «Alarmes i recordatoris»`. Leave the status lines `preciseAlarmsAvailable` and `approximateAlarmsHelp` as they are; this round only fixes the button.

2. UX-436 (R1B-2): `remindersOnConfirmation` (`Listo. Te avisaremos antes de cada tarea con hora.`, reminder_control.dart:102) shows even when exact alarms are still off, and it is wrong for tasks without a time (they remind at 9:00, not ‘before’). After the sheet (and requestExactAccess when allowed), read `access.capability()` again. If exact is still false, end with `showFeedback(messenger, strings.exactAlarmsNeeded)` instead of the confirmation, with no action button. Otherwise show the confirmation, whose value becomes EN `Done. Reminders are on.` / ES `Listo. Recordatorios activados.` / CA `Fet. Recordatoris activats.` Keep the permission-refused and save-error paths as they are.
Run gen-l10n. Update the tests that look for the old strings (P8's notes name `Permitir alarmas exactas` and `Listo. Te avisaremos antes de cada tarea con hora.`).
Don't touch: the order of the steps in turnOnReminders, the 9:00 default, `asked`, the card (P48), or any other Notificaciones text.
acceptance: Widget test in Spanish, with ReminderAccess faked as permission granted and exact alarms off: the sheet's button reads `Permitir «Alarmas y recordatorios»`. When the sheet is closed without allowing, the snackbar reads `Para que el aviso llegue a su hora, permite «Alarmas y recordatorios».`, and `Listo. Recordatorios activados.` doesn't appear.
Widget test in Spanish, with exact alarms on: turning reminders on from the chip shows `Listo. Recordatorios activados.`
Widget test: on Notificaciones in Spanish, with exact alarms off, the button reads `Permitir «Alarmas y recordatorios»`.
Code: the EN catalog has `Allow “Alarms & reminders”` and `Done. Reminders are on.`; the CA catalog has `Permet «Alarmes i recordatoris»` and `Fet. Recordatoris activats.`
deviceChecks: Android 14 phone: turn reminders on, then go back from the exact-alarm screen without allowing. The last message asks for «Alarmas y recordatorios»; it doesn't say `Listo`.
